description: This Java source file defines a class 'DateTimeConverters' that contains multiple nested classes for converting between various date, time, duration, and SQL timestamp types. It provides methods for converting Calendar, Date, Timestamp, Time, and Duration objects, including localized and formatted conversions, and registers these converters for use within the OFBiz framework.

classes.description: Converts a Calendar object to a Date object.

classes.description: Converts a Calendar object to its millisecond representation as Long.

classes.description: Converts a Calendar object to a formatted String based on locale and timezone.

classes.description: Converts a Calendar object to a SQL Timestamp.
